corrected_findings: Explicit nix-command required by path-info on the previous host configuration
Initial metadata without PREPARED can restart only a complete preflight after same-release/no-effects validation
RETURNING without an adoption marker does not require or extract a nonexistent snapshot
Old periodic worker services, not only their timers, remain masked until the durable RETURNED boundary
limits: The Nix feature check invokes the real local nix tool; service, network-gate and generation operations are injected.
The preflight metadata decision uses disposable local files and substitutes ownership validation; root ownership is not qualified by this test.
Full production generation, systemd, nftables and reboot qualification remain separate receipts.
scope: Independent local review of first-cutover and interrupted recovery boundaries; no production or service operation
